productConcept.name: VERDURE
productConcept.description: Slow editorial typographic studio — publishes rare-type specimen books and monographs on typeface history. Clients: type foundries, museum publishing, private press collectors.
productConcept.rationale: Typography-first design system with 900:300 weight ratio as the hierarchy mechanism maps precisely onto a publishing studio where type IS the product — the system's editorial restraint, warm paper surfaces, and architectural display headlines feel native to a studio that argues for type through physical printed specimens.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — motion.json has word-slide and weight-pulse keyframes, 0.7s reveal duration, stagger tokens. concept_by_video.md describes scroll reveals with editorial restraint.
